task.title: Scale a Kubernetes Deployment and verify rollout status
task.shortdesc: Increase or decrease replicas for a Deployment and confirm the change is applied safely.

step.cmd: Check current replica count: kubectl get deploy <app> -n <ns>.
Scale the Deployment: kubectl scale deploy <app> --replicas=<n> -n <ns>.
Watch Pods converge to the desired count: kubectl get pods -n <ns> -l app=<app> -w.
Verify rollout status is healthy: kubectl rollout status deploy/<app> -n <ns>.
Confirm endpoints match replicas: kubectl get endpoints <serviceName> -n <ns>.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
